title: Hull
description: One individual ship: identity, dates, status, refits and the component fit it is currently carrying. Stats live on the ShipClass; a hull carries only what makes it this ship rather than its sister.

name.description: Ship name. OMITTED where the navy does not name this class of ship — see pennant. A fleet that names only its battle line leaves this absent on everything below it, and that absence is data, not a gap.

pennant.description: Pennant or hull number. For a navy whose ships below the battle line carry a number and no name, this is the ship's whole identity.

pct_complete.description: Only meaningful when completed is null (ship building/converting).

status.description: Status at the containing fleet file's as_of date. The date lives in as_of and in the scenario clock, NEVER in this field's name — a fleet file must be authorable for any snapshot year (1922, 1930, 1936, 1941), which is exactly what scenario-design.md's per-server start dates require.

treaty_fate.description: Historical outcome under the Washington Treaty; the default script for the campaign's treaty engine. Meaningful only in a file whose as_of sits inside the Washington system; omit it elsewhere.

assignment.description: Fleet or station at the file's as_of date.

fit.description: Component codes currently installed. The ship's derived designation is built from these (conventions 1.2) and is never stored. A code here must resolve in an equipment file for this hull's nation.

refits.description: Stat deltas applied on top of the class, in date order.

fits.description: Component codes installed by this refit.

lands.description: Component codes removed by this refit.

deltas.description: JSON-merge-patch style overrides onto class stats.
